items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 你好呀，亲爱的朋友。冬契军司令薇斯纳，向你致意。礼炮和仪仗队都已经就位了，随时可以为你奏响。当然，如果你不习惯张扬，我也准备了更私人的欢迎仪式，快快跟上~
items.text_en: Hello, dear friend. Commander Vesna of the Druzhna. The pleasure is all mine. The gun salute and honor guard are in position and ready for your grand welcome. Of course, if you're not one for fanfare, I've also arranged a more private welcome ceremony. Come on, this way~

items.title: 闲聊·效劳
items.text: 冬契军只听命于女皇陛下，当然不能随随便便就为你效劳了。但，风仙薇斯纳可以噢，亲爱的朋友。
items.text_en: The Druzhna takes orders only from the Tsaritsa, so they cannot be at your beck and call. But Vesna the Vila is happy to be of service, my dear friend.

items.title: 闲聊·快乐
items.text: 这身仪装好看吧？陛下亲赐的，多看几眼也无妨。
items.text_en: Isn't this outfit just gorgeous? It was a personal gift from Her Majesty. Hehe, that's right, feast your eyes.

items.title: 闲聊·高效
items.text: 案牍工作？早做完啦，花不了多久。接下来都算巡视时间，走~
items.text_en: What paperwork? Oh, I finished it ages ago — flew through it. Now it's time to get out on patrol. C'mon, let's go~

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 妖精当然也会着凉，淋湿了要赶快扇干，我指翅膀。
items.text_en: Fae can absolutely catch colds. When they get wet, it's important to flap them dry right away. T—The wings, I mean.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 白茫茫的雪地里，任何一点伪装的瑕疵都会变得极为致命。走路当心点哦，亲爱的朋友。
items.text_en: In the snow, the slightest imperfection in your camouflage can be fatal. So tread carefully, dear friend.

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 我知道我知道，阳光下我的翅膀最是闪亮。
items.text_en: I know what you're thinking — and I agree. My wings look their most dazzling in the sun.

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 不错，是风仙喜欢的天气。
items.text_en: Ah... Hehe, very nice. The Vila just love a good breeze.

items.title: 在沙漠的时候
items.text: 随口一问…我们什么时候回至冬？
items.text_en: Just wondering... When are we heading back to Snezhnaya again?

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 新的一天！向你问候，至冬堡！
items.text_en: A new day! Good morning, Snezhnograd!

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 走吧，去老庭院餐厅！当然依旧是我请客咯。
items.text_en: Off we go to Podvorye Restaurant, come on! My treat, of course. As always!

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 科洛列夫茨基剧团有新的演出。除了沃雅妮莎首席的高音、奥黛塔小姐的舞步…还有一些「新的朋友」。
items.text_en: The Korolevskiy Troupe is debuting a new show tonight. Featuring Prima Donna Vodyanitsa's high soprano, Miss Odette latest choreography... and a few "new friends."

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 嘶嘶…这就要睡了吗？要出去散步吗？有极光欸！
items.text_en: Pssst... You can't be asleep already. Come out for a late-night walk? The aurora is great tonight!

items.title: 关于薇斯纳自己·「魔法武器」
items.text: 看到我身边飞来飞去的「小家伙」了吗？是我造的「魔法武器」，每一把都是用元素力和我自己的意识糅合出来的，多多少少带了点我的脾气哦。所以它们有可能会缠着你邀玩，请不要介意。当然，可以的话也请不要拒绝啦，呵呵！
items.text_en: See these little things flying around me? They're my magic weapons, my own creations. Each one is a blend of elemental energy and my own will, so they've inherited something of my personality as well. Which is to say, it's possible that they might pester you to play with them. Don't mind them... Though of course, if you have time, please indulge them, hehe!

items.title: 关于薇斯纳自己·司令官
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启司令官的「架子」…噗。这种东西是给镇不住场子的人准备的，我不需要~这点我们是一样的哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Who says a commander needs to be strict and imposing? Pshh, that's for people with no presence. I don't need it~ I think we're quite similar in that regard.

items.title: 关于我们·求证
items.text: 我懂我懂，你肯定有许多关于我的传闻想求证。没关系，我们有的是时间。不过作为交换，关于你的一切，我也会一点一点地「求证」清楚哦。
items.text_en: I get it, I get it. There are all sorts of rumors flying around about me, and you want to know the truth. Well, that's fine, we have plenty of time for that. But in return, I want to know the truth about you, too, down to the very last detail.

items.title: 关于我们·同行
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启我不习惯「陪谁人走一段路」这种说法。听上去是很浪漫，可仔细一想…「陪」这个字，把一个人放在了主角的位置，另一个人则成了陪衬。可脚是自己迈的呀，沿途的经历和收获，也从来都是自己的。所以呀，我不会说「陪你」，而是很高兴「与你同行」。这种感觉就像，走着走着，一转头却发现…哈哈好巧哦，居然刚好顺路！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I don't like the idea of "accompanying" someone on a journey. It sounds romantic at first, but when you think about it, the word "accompany" makes one person the protagonist and the other a mere sidekick.The truth is, every step we take is our own, as are the things we experience and the ways we grow along the way. So, I won't say that I'm "accompanying" you on your journey — rather that I'm glad to have the pleasure of your company on what happens to be, for now, a shared journey. Think of it like this... you're walking along, minding your own business, then at some point you turn your head and notice: Oh wow! Haha, look at that — seems like we're both going the same way!

items.title: 关于「星之楔」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启「星之楔」的样式非常漂亮，很有收藏价值。说到这个，「月之轮」也很不错，我一直挺心动的。至于「神之眼」…暂不考虑呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Stellar Linchpins are beautifully designed. Absolutely a collector's item. Actually, Moon Wheels aren't bad, either. Always wanted to get my hands on one. As for Visions, though... Not interested at the moment, sorry.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 我手上这柄「老伙计」？漂亮吧！是家族传下来的噢，它的年纪比我大得多得多了，说是殿堂级的古董也不为过。它有时被我当成魔法杖，有时是教杖，有时是指挥棒…哎呀，比起将它锁进银行的保险柜里吃灰，我让它在这把年纪还能发挥余热，先祖们想必夸我还来不及呢。
items.text_en: Oh, you mean this old thing? Beautiful, isn't it? It's a family heirloom, you know. Much, much older than I am. A true antique, in fact, worthy of a museum. Sometimes I use it as a magic wand, sometimes as a pointer when giving a class, and sometimes as a commander's baton... Ah, just look at me, giving it the chance to relive its glory days at this ripe old age, rather than locking it up in a bank vault somewhere to gather dust. My ancestors would be lining up to sing my praises if they knew!

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 霜仙花美丽又顽强，在严寒的地方都能存活下来。花纹也很特别，我喜欢半眯着眼，晃着脑袋看它，眼里的景象就会像万花筒一样，特别梦幻。但你最好在没人在旁时再尝试。
items.text_en: The Frostfairy Flower is a thing of beauty and resilience, surviving in spite of the brutally cold environment. It also has a very distinctive pattern. I like gazing at it through half-closed eyes as I shake my head, hehe — it creates a dreamy effect, like looking through a kaleidoscope. That said, I'd advise doing that in a private place with no one else around.

items.title: 关于「女皇」陛下·忠诚
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我抓过太多自以为是、想要跟陛下唱反调的家伙了。他们嘴里的宏图霸业，全是不堪一击的花拳绣腿。既没有举事的谋略，也没有成事的能力。跟那些所谓的野心家相比…不，我收回这些话。他们不配跟陛下相提并论。简而言之，效忠陛下，既是风仙一族的职责，更是我薇斯纳个人的选择哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've apprehended far too many self-righteous fools who wish to oppose Her Majesty. Their grand speeches about conquest? All show and no substance. They have neither the strategy to launch a rebellion nor the competence to see it through. Compared to those would-be revolutionaries... No, I take that back. They don't even deserve to be mentioned in the same breath as Her Majesty.My point is, serving the Tsaritsa is not only my duty as a Vila. It's also my personal choice as Vesna.

items.title: 关于「女皇」陛下·慈爱
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「往冥府的安魂歌」剧情「慈爱」这个词在陛下口中总是带着冰刺的。她说那是天理强加给神明的诅咒，不是真正的爱。可我偏偏不这么想哦。讨伐魔兽归来，陛下会在手谕末尾添上一句「好好休息」。生之执政的能力被回收后，她也照顾到了我明明藏得很好的失落，把没被回收的部分送回到我这里…但这些，以陛下的身份，她本可以不必做的。这么说可能有些僭越，我始终认为，一个神明到底有没有「爱」，应该由子民说了算！所以我说的也算？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A Rekviem for the Underworld"Her Majesty always speaks the word "compassion" with an icy sting to it. She says it's a curse imposed upon the gods by the Heavenly Principles, not genuine love. But I very much disagree. Whenever I return from a campaign against monsters, Her Majesty adds "rest well" at the end of her personal decree. And after the Ruler of Life's power was reclaimed, she sensed how disappointed I was, despite my efforts to hide it, and sent the unclaimed portion back to me...Someone in her position has no obligation to do any of these things. At the risk of sounding presumptuous, I've always believed that the question of whether a god is truly loving can only be answered by their people. So why shouldn't my verdict count?

items.title: 关于达妮卡·小时候
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我们亲爱的达妮卡小姐，别看她现在严肃又深沉，小时候，她可是跟我一起策划过「掀开老师面罩」这种事的捣蛋鬼哦，我们还成功爬到了老师肩膀上呢！虽然最后没得逞，反被罚在冰湖上站了很久军姿…哦不，这点糗事不是重点！重点是，这个鬼点子明明是她先提出来的，要说贪玩，她可一点都不输我。现在倒好，整天对我摆出一副大人看小孩般无语的表情。拜托哦，我才是姐姐。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, dearest Miss Danica... Don't be fooled by her serious and brooding demeanor. We got up to all kinds of mischief together when we were little... Like the time we plotted to steal Teacher's mask right off of his face. We made it all the way up onto his shoulders before getting caught! Sure, we didn't quite pull it off, and yes, we got punished — had to stand at attention on a frozen lake for hours... Ah, but anyway, that's besides the point! She was the one who came up with that crazy idea in the first place! She was every bit the troublemaker I was. And now she gives me that look all the time, like she's the adult and I'm the child. I mean, puh-lease. I'm actually the older one.

items.title: 关于达妮卡·吵架
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启据可靠线报称，有嫌疑人借着举办「吵架大赛」这种莫名其妙的活动为噱头，趁人群起哄之际完成不法交易…我必须管管了。所以，我已经替达妮卡报名了，她很擅长「冷面拆台、专戳软肋」，谁能吵得过她呀？一定能帮我拖延很多时间吧。加油啊，达妮卡！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4We have good intel that certain suspects are using bizarre events like "Quarreling Contests" as a front to conduct illegal business transactions, the rowdy crowd serving as a handy distraction... And so, it falls to me to intervene.To that end, I've taken the liberty of signing Danica up. She's a master of deadpan takedowns and hitting people where it hurts. No one can out-quarrel her, so she'll definitely buy me tons of time.Counting on you, Danica!

items.title: 关于「队长」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「炽烈的还魂诗」剧情印象里他的背影总是那么宽厚又可靠，像一座沉稳的大山。我从未想过有一天大山也会倒下，至少…没想过会这么快…什么「真正的战场不存在告别的机会」，那也用不着亲身向我证明吧，连最后的机会…都没有留给我。太坏了，我的老师。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection"I always remember how he looked from behind. So sturdy and reliable, like a steadfast mountain. I never imagined there'd come a day when that mountain would fall. Or at least... I didn't think it would come so soon. He always used to say, "In a real war, you don't get the chance to say goodbye." Of all the ways to prove it to me... Surely, he could have given me one last chance before the end, but he didn't...I'll never let that go, Teach.

items.title: 关于「丑角」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启这个世界上，有些人脚步轻盈，他们大多期盼着走向明天。而他，始终走得很沉重。我时常觉得他和老师很相似，大概是因为他们都把难以想象的悲伤藏在面具底下，把沉痛的过去全都背在身上了吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Some people skip through the world with a pep in their step, most of them full of hope for what tomorrow will bring. Not him. His steps are always slow and heavy. I always felt that he and my teacher were similar people. I guess it's because they both hide unimaginable sorrow beneath a mask, bearing all the pain of the past on their shoulders.

items.title: 关于「公鸡」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启市长先生在皇都评议会上侃侃发言，游刃有余的样子，显得他非常伟岸。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Mr. Mayor speaks with such eloquence and composure at the Snezhnograd Veche, and he makes it look so effortless. He can really command the room.

items.title: 关于「富人」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启冬契军司令的薪水不算低，可要用来随心所欲购买收藏品和请客吃饭还是会有些吃紧…哦哦，我不是那个意思，听我说完嘛。从记事起，家族的「闲钱」就经由北国银行打理，托潘塔罗涅先生的福，收益滚动到现在已经非常可观了。所以我完全没有什么负担啦，你不用客气，下次还是让我来请客！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Now, I'm not saying that a Druzhna Commander's salary is low, but it can get a little tight if you're an avid collector who also enjoys treating people to meals... No, oh, no no no, I didn't mean it like that! I wasn't finished. Ever since I can remember, my family's spare funds have been managed by the Northland Bank, and thanks to Mr. Pantalone, the compound returns have grown our wealth quite substantially. Basically, I don't have to worry about money at all. So next time we're out, it's still my treat, and no need to hold back!

items.title: 关于「木偶」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启桑多涅的举止完全符合淑女的标准，言语却又带有极强的「攻击性」，同时逻辑经得起推敲，无可挑剔…太有意思了，嘻嘻，我要好好学学。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sandrone fully embodies what it means to be a lady. Her words may be highly aggressive in nature, but her impeccable logic makes it impossible to find fault with her... Hehe, it really fascinates me. I must learn how she does it.

items.title: 关于米提亚
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启米提亚是我固定的游戏玩伴，他总能想办法从军械宫溜出来，我们三个每次都玩得很尽兴！哪来的三个？我，米提亚，还有他那条聪明的围巾。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Mitya often joins me for hijinks. He's forever sneaking out of the Armory, and the three of us always have a blast! Why "three," you ask? Because there's me, Mitya, and his ever-so-clever scarf.

items.title: 关于沃雅妮莎
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启沃雅妮莎小姐的每一首歌都很好听，我非常享受在现场听歌的感觉。跟台下的大多数观众一样，我也会随着她的歌声时而欢笑时而流泪。有时候演唱结束后，大家还会自发留在现场大合唱。巧了不是，我手上正好有一根指挥棒呢。更巧的是，有好几次我都发现了悄悄混入人群的沃雅妮莎小姐，她换下演出服戴上了帽子，在为大家和声呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Every one of Miss Vodyanitsa's songs is simply beautiful. I love hearing them live. At times they fill me with joy, at other times they move me to tears, just like everyone else in the audience. Sometimes, everyone stays behind after the show ends and suddenly breaks into song together. Well, funnily enough, I just so happen to have a conductor's baton in my hand. And even more funnily, I've noticed on several occasions that Miss Vodyanitsa quietly blends into the crowd after changing out of her stage outfit, puts on a hat, and sings a harmony for the group.

items.title: 关于奥黛塔
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启其实每一次奥黛塔小姐来参与朝会，我都会忍不住多瞄她几眼。毕竟，她除了是愚人众的一员，另有个「特殊」的身份，让人很难不在意…我指的当然是科洛列夫茨基剧团的首席芭蕾舞者呀，不然呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I have to be honest — every time I see Miss Odette at a court gathering, I find myself stealing a glance at her constantly. After all, as well as being a member of the Fatui, she has a special alter ego that makes her hard to ignore... Hmm? Why, her role as prima ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe, of course. What did you think I meant?

items.title: 关于阿罗夏
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我明白的，哪只小狗能拒绝在「呼啸」的狂风里，去追逐一只漂亮的蝴蝶呢？呜…我把达妮卡的早餐偷出来给图加林吃吧，再请阿罗夏帮我美言几句，拜托它不要一见面就追着我跑啦…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I get it, I really do. I mean, how could any little puppy resist the urge to chase a pretty butterfly through the "howling" winds? Hmm... Maybe I'll steal Danica's breakfast and feed it to Tugarin, then ask Alyosha to put in a good word for me, so he doesn't come charging at me the moment he sees me...

items.title: 想要了解薇斯纳·其一
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启嘻嘻，想通过什么方式了解我？不会真的只是聊天吧？那多没意思…不玩点「真假话大冒险」之类的游戏吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 2Hehe, so how would you like to get to know me? Surely, we're not just going to chat? Well, that's no fun... Hmm... Can't we play a game of "Truth or Dare" instead?

items.title: 想要了解薇斯纳·其二
items.text: 好感等级达到3后开启冬契军是直属于女皇陛下的亲卫部队。职责嘛，可不仅仅是讨伐魔兽、参与战事这类军务哦。举凡一切关乎女皇陛下权威与荣誉之事，冬契军皆需无条件听候陛下差遣，为陛下扫清前路上的一切障碍。不过，在对抗天理的伟业尘埃落定前，陛下难免分身乏术。所以其他诸如开幕剪彩、参加晚宴这种好事…咳咳，这类琐事，我非常乐意效劳。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3We Druzhna are the Tsaritsa's personal guard, answering directly to Her Majesty. Our duties aren't just limited to neutralizing monster threats and going into battle — they extend beyond military affairs. In all matters concerning Her Majesty's authority and honor, we are bound to answer her call unconditionally and remove all obstacles from her path.However, Her Majesty is inevitably spread a little thin while the grand endeavor against the Heavenly Principles is ongoing. So until the dust has settled, I am more than happy to assist her with the fun stuff— Ahem, I mean, the more trivial matters, such as ribbon-cutting ceremonies and attending banquets on her behalf.

items.title: 想要了解薇斯纳·其三
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我的收藏品有许多，珠宝啦古籍啦油画啦…任何能让我开心的物件都值得被我收藏。而且我必须第一时间拿下，一秒钟都不想等！不是有那样一句话吗，「勺子在午餐时才珍贵」。错过了那一瞬间的心动，往后再得到，味道也就淡了大半啦。所以当下想要，当下就要得到。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I have an eclectic collection of treasures. Jewelry, ancient books, oil paintings... Anything that makes me happy is worth adding to the collection. And I have to have it the moment I lay eyes upon it, not a single second can be wasted! You know the saying, don't you? "A spoon is dear when lunch time is near." If you wait until after the initial thrill has passed before acquiring it, it loses it appeal. So, if I want it now, I must have it now.

items.title: 想要了解薇斯纳·其四
items.text: 好感等级达到5后开启莫诺马赫皇帝牺牲后，至冬曾经经历过一段动荡时期。我的先祖在那时便坚定站在女皇陛下这边，我们的荣耀从未曾折翼——那么，站在他们肩膀上的我，究竟有没有青出于蓝的实力呢？哼哼，我已经把你心中的疑问说出来了。是啊，有没有呢？现在轮到你把我心中的答案说出来了，请~
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5After Tsar Monomakh's sacrifice, Snezhnaya went through a period of great turmoil. My forebears stood firmly by the Tsaritsa's side. So, as I stand here on their shoulders today, do I really possess the strength to do justice to their legacy? Hehe, I've put words to the question in your mind, haven't I? Well, now it's your turn to voice the answer that's in mine. Go ahead~

items.title: 想要了解薇斯纳·其五
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启完成「往冥府的安魂歌」剧情对抗死之执政的前夕，我提取了许多人的「生之印」，大家对于美好回忆的定义各不相同：有人珍视的，是与家人围坐在壁炉边，有一搭没一搭地闲聊。有人念念不忘的，是独自坐在火车窗边，看极光在夜空里静静流淌。还有人，只是拉着雪橇去冰钓，便觉得满足…那些回忆，就像一个个五彩斑斓的泡泡，附带着滚烫又鲜活的「生命力」，让人想要不自觉地感叹——啊，活着真好！可所谓的天上的存在，却能轻而易举地将这些泡泡碾碎，连一句解释都吝于给予。凭什么啊？从那一刻起，对我而言，对抗天理，便不再仅仅是为了辅助陛下。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "A Rekviem for the Underworld"On the eve of the battle against the Ruler of Death, I extracted "Seals of Life" from many people. Everyone's definition of a beautiful memory varies. Some cherish sitting around the fireplace with family, chatting idly. Some fondly remember sitting alone by a train window, watching the aurora drift silently across the night sky. Still others are satisfied simply pulling a sled out for some ice fishing...Those memories are like iridescent bubbles, filled with an effervescence and vitality that just makes you want to exclaim: "Ah, it's so good to be alive!"Yet, those so-called heavenly beings can crush those bubbles with ease, without giving a single word of explanation. What gives them that right?From that moment on, for me, the fight against the Heavenly Principles was no longer solely about assisting Her Majesty.

items.title: 薇斯纳的爱好
items.text: 很小的时候，家中就给我安排了绘画，舞蹈和声乐老师，稍微长大一些了，我就开始练习击剑和马术等等…近期嘛，我迷上了听歌剧，看演出，还有搞点小小的收藏…总之我的生活里没有「无聊」两个字。
items.text_en: When I was very young, my family arranged for me to take painting, dance, and singing classes. As I got a little older, I took up fencing, horse riding, and the like, hehe... More recently, I've been getting into opera, theater, and collecting my little treasures... In short, the word "bored" doesn't exist in my dictionary.

items.title: 薇斯纳的烦恼
items.text: 别听达妮卡胡说，我的开车技术真不差，那叫人车合一。等我的开车禁令解除后，就载你去兜风吧！
items.text_en: Don't listen to Danica's nonsense — there is absolutely nothing wrong with my driving skills. It's called being one with the vehicle! Just wait till my driving ban is lifted. I'll take you for a spin!

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 天气这么冷，没有什么比围在一起喝点炖汤更让人惬意的了！这样吧，我来组局，你跟派蒙随便拿点食材来就好啦~
items.text_en: When it's so cold out, there's nothing cozier than gathering everyone together for some nice hot stew! Tell you what — I'll host, and you and Paimon can bring along some cooking ingredients. Anything you like will do~

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 嘿嘿！烦人的蔬菜统统挑到达妮卡的盘子里噜！呜——又被夹回来了…
items.text_en: Hehe! I'm slipping all those annoying veggies onto Danica's plate! Ugh... but they always come right back to me...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 那么，我不客气啦，把美味统统收藏进肚子里。
items.text_en: Oh, don't mind if I do! I'm going to savor every last bite.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 嗯嗯…烹饪的巧思吗…嗯嗯…我再尝一口。
items.text_en: Mmm... Quite a feat of culinary ingenuity... I think I'll take another bite.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 我吃饱啦谢谢！这些我打包给达妮卡吃~
items.text_en: Oof... I'm sorry, I already ate! But let me box them up for Danica~

items.title: 生日
items.text: 铛铛铛铛，时间到！你知道我昨天憋得有多辛苦吗？提前说出那句祝福可是会被暴风雪吞没的！现在终于可以说了——生日快乐！亲爱的朋友。愿你像白桦树一样强壮，永远不被风雪打败。好啦，按照习俗，接下来我要轻轻揪几下寿星的耳朵咯——
items.text_en: Ding-dong! The moment has arrived! You have no idea how hard it was for me to hold it in yesterday... But I had to, because saying it early is bad luck — you might get swallowed up by a snowstorm! Now, I can finally say it: Happy Birthday, my dear friend. May you stand as strong as the birch tree, never defeated by the wind and snow.Alright, that part's done. Next, tradition dictates that I've got to give our birthday superstar a few gentle tugs on the ear...

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 突破等级「1」阶后开启新兵训练第一课：风雪压不弯的脊背，才有资格护卫在陛下左右。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1First lesson in boot camp: Only those who do not stand firm and do not yield to the wind and snow are qualified to stand guard by Her Majesty's side.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 突破等级「2」阶后开启新兵训练第二课：握剑的手不许抖。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Second lesson in boot camp: Your sword arm must never tremble.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 突破等级「4」阶后开启新兵训练第三课：敌人面前不许哭。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Third lesson in boot camp: We do not weep before our foes.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 突破等级「6」阶后开启而我亲爱的朋友，你教给了我另一课：留一丝柔软，去拥抱风雪后，值得拔剑守护的人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6You, dear friend, have taught me a lesson from beyond boot camp: To reserve a soft touch with which to embrace those I defend with my sword after the blizzard has died down.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 列队。
items.text_en: Form up!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 敬礼。
items.text_en: Salute.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 举剑。
items.text_en: Raise your swords!

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 让一让~
items.text_en: Coming through~

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 没结束哦。
items.text_en: More where that came from.

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: 向您致意。
items.text_en: Kindest regards.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 陪你们玩玩吧！
items.text_en: Haha, alright. Let's play!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 瞄准——逃不掉咯！
items.text_en: Locked on — no escape!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 献予女皇陛下——
items.text_en: For the Tsaritsa!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 嚯嚯，新藏品入库！
items.text_en: Hoho, another piece for my grand collection!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 你一件，我一件，陛下一件，我一件，分完了！达妮卡没有，哈哈。
items.text_en: One for you, one for me, one for Her Majesty, and another for me! None for Danica, hehe!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 这呢这呢，看这里！
items.text_en: Well, lookee here!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 司令官当然要留守在战场上。
items.text_en: A commander stays on the field.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 放心，我能躲开哦。
items.text_en: Don't worry, I'll dodge the rest...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 咳…暂时的劣势…
items.text_en: Ahem... Just a temporary setback...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 撤退，由冬契军接管。
items.text_en: Fall back. The Druzhna will take it from here.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 别逞强，亲爱的朋友。
items.text_en: Don't push yourself, my dear friend.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 飞不起来了…
items.text_en: My wings... are clipped...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 永远效忠…女皇陛下…
items.text_en: Long live... the Tsaritsa...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 我不痛…只是不甘心…
items.text_en: I'm not in pain... just denial...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 什么动静？
items.text_en: Excuse me?

items.title: 普通受击·其二
items.text: 哈？
items.text_en: Huh?

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 你竟敢！
items.text_en: Very bold!

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 真无礼！
items.text_en: How rude!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 巡视时间到~
items.text_en: Time for a patrol~

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 我看看——有什么好玩的呢？
items.text_en: I hope you have something fun planned!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 那就等你的号令咯？
items.text_en: At your service, commander...
